title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,551–3,600 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 咖啡師；專業吧檯咖啡調理師

examples.en: The award-winning barista calibrated the grinder meticulously for morning espresso.
examples.zh: 冠軍咖啡師大清早便全神貫注精細校準磨豆機刻度，以萃取出完美的黃金濃縮。

examples.en: She trained for months to become a skilled barista at the specialty café.
examples.zh: 她在精品咖啡館接受了數個月的嚴格培訓，成為一名手藝精湛的專業咖啡師。

examples.en: A friendly barista greeted each customer by name and remembered their usual drink order.
examples.zh: 親切熱情的咖啡師親切地稱呼每位顧客的名字，並熟記他們平時習慣點的咖啡。

examples.en: A double shot of espresso forms the rich, aromatic base for cappuccinos.
examples.zh: 一份雙份義式濃縮咖啡（Double Espresso）是調製香濃卡布奇諾的靈魂基底。

examples.en: He ordered a quick single espresso at the counter before heading to his morning meeting.
examples.zh: 他在吧檯前點了一杯單份義式濃縮咖啡一飲而盡，隨後精神奕奕地前往晨會。

examples.en: Authentic Italian espresso is brewed under high pressure to create a thick golden crema.
examples.zh: 正宗的義式濃縮咖啡在高壓高溫下萃取而成，表面浮現一層厚實細密的金黃咖啡油脂（Crema）。

examples.en: Pour-over coffee highlights the delicate floral and citrus notes of Geisha beans.
examples.zh: 手沖咖啡能極致放大並完美展現藝妓咖啡豆細膩雅緻的白花香與柑橘果酸。

examples.en: She enjoys the relaxing ritual of brewing fresh pour-over coffee every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 她十分享受每個週日早晨為自己沖泡一杯新鮮手沖滴濾咖啡的療癒儀式感。

examples.en: Pour-over brewing allows for precise extraction control through water flow and temperature.
examples.zh: 手沖咖啡沖煮法能藉由細膩控制水流速度與沖泡水溫，精準調整咖啡的萃取風味。

examples.en: The iconic conical V60 dripper allows precise control over water extraction speed.
examples.zh: 經典的錐形 V60 螺旋肋骨手沖濾杯讓咖啡師能精準掌控注水萃取流速與節奏。

examples.en: Ceramic and glass coffee drippers retain heat better than plastic ones during brewing.
examples.zh: 陶瓷與耐熱玻璃製成的手沖濾杯在沖煮過程中比塑膠濾杯更具備優異的保溫蓄熱性。

examples.en: Place a folded paper filter securely inside the conical dripper before adding ground beans.
examples.zh: 在倒入研磨咖啡粉之前，先將摺疊好的專用濾紙妥善服貼平整地置入錐形濾杯中。

examples.en: A temperature-controlled gooseneck kettle ensures a steady, gentle water stream.
examples.zh: 具備精準溫控功能的細口鵝頸手沖壺能提供極致穩定、柔順細膩的注水水柱。

examples.en: Fill the electric kettle with filtered water and bring it to a boil for afternoon tea.
examples.zh: 將過濾後的純淨水注入電熱水壺中煮沸，準備享受悠閒的英式下午茶時光。

examples.en: The barista held the slender gooseneck kettle steady while pouring concentric circles over the coffee bed.
examples.zh: 咖啡師穩穩握持細長嘴鵝頸壺，由內向外在咖啡粉層表面均勻注入同心圓水流。

examples.en: Precision burr grinders produce uniform grounds with minimal powdery fines.
examples.zh: 高精密的錐刀與平刀磨豆機能研磨出粒徑極為均勻的咖啡粉，大幅減少細粉干擾。

examples.en: Clean the coffee grinder blades regularly to prevent stale coffee oils from altering taste.
examples.zh: 定期細心清理磨豆機的研磨刀盤，能避免殘留的陳舊咖啡油脂氧化變質影響風味。

examples.en: He bought a manual conical grinder for fresh coffee during outdoor camping trips.
examples.zh: 他特地添購了一台便攜手搖錐刀磨豆機，方便在戶外露營野炊時隨時研磨現泡咖啡。

examples.en: French press and cold brew methods require a coarse coffee grind size.
examples.zh: 法式濾壓壺與冷萃咖啡沖泡法皆需要使用顆粒較大如粗海鹽般的粗研磨咖啡粉。

examples.en: The texture of the sandpaper was too coarse for fine furniture polishing.
examples.zh: 這款砂紙的顆粒過於粗糙，不太適合用來做高級實木家具的精細拋光作業。

examples.en: Season the steak with coarse sea salt and cracked black pepper before grilling.
examples.zh: 在將厚切牛排送上烤網碳烤之前，先均勻撒上天然粗海鹽與現磨黑胡椒碎醃漬入味。

words.definition: 單品產區的；單一莊園的

examples.en: Coffee lovers appreciate single-origin beans sourced directly from Alishan farms.
examples.zh: 頂級老饕由衷讚賞直接採購自阿里山特富野部落的高海拔單品莊園咖啡原豆。

examples.en: Single-origin coffees express the distinct terroir and climate of a specific region.
examples.zh: 單品產區莊園咖啡能清晰傳遞出特定種植產地獨特的風土條件與高山微氣候特色。

examples.en: The shop specializes in single-origin chocolate bars made from Venezuelan cocoa beans.
examples.zh: 這家精品小店專營以委內瑞拉特定可可莊園產地豆純手工精製的頂級單品黑巧克力。

words.definition: 配方豆；混合咖啡豆；融合調配

examples.en: The café’s signature house blend combines nutty Brazilian and fruity Ethiopian beans.
examples.zh: 這家獨立咖啡館的招牌配方豆完美融合了巴西堅果可可調與衣索比亞花果香氣。

examples.en: The artist used a soft brush to blend the watercolor shades across the paper smoothly.
examples.zh: 畫家運用柔軟的羊毛水彩筆，將紙面上的各色水彩漸層柔和細膩地暈染交融。

examples.en: This soothing herbal blend combines dried chamomile, mint leaves, and sweet lemongrass.
examples.zh: 這款舒緩安神的無咖啡因花草複方茶融合了天然乾燥洋甘菊、薄荷葉與香甜檸檬草。

examples.en: Light roast coffees preserve bright fruit acidity and complex floral aromas.
examples.zh: 淺度烘焙咖啡能最大程度保留生豆原生奔放的明亮果酸與層次豐富的花香。

examples.en: We plan to roast a whole chicken with garlic and rosemary for Sunday dinner.
examples.zh: 我們打算在週日晚餐時，烘烤一隻塞滿大蒜瓣與新鮮迷迭香的大烤雞全雞。

examples.en: Dark roast beans feature bold, smoky profiles with notes of dark baker's cocoa.
examples.zh: 深度烘焙咖啡豆呈現濃烈深沉的迷人煙燻炭香，並夾帶著濃郁的黑巧克力可可風味。

words.definition: 咖啡烘豆師；大型烘豆機

examples.en: Master coffee roasters carefully monitor bean temperature and drum airflow.
examples.zh: 專業資深咖啡烘豆師在烘焙過程中全程緊盯爐溫變化曲線與鍋爐風門抽風數據。

examples.en: The local coffee roaster supplies fresh whole beans to restaurants throughout the city.
examples.zh: 這家地方獨立咖啡烘焙豆廠為全城市數十家優質餐廳提供每週現烘新鮮咖啡豆。

examples.en: She invested in a cast-iron drum roaster to start her own small-batch roasting business.
examples.zh: 她購置了一台專業鑄鐵滾筒式小型烘豆機，正式開啟了她的自家微型手作烘豆事業。

examples.en: Professional Q-graders scored the green coffee beans during official blind cupping.
examples.zh: 擁有國際 Q-Grader 認證的專業杯測師在嚴格的盲測杯測會上為各莊園生豆評分。

examples.en: Coffee cupping involves slurping brew from a spoon to aerate aromas onto the palate.
examples.zh: 專業咖啡杯測需要運用杯測匙用力吸啜咖啡液，讓香氣在鼻腔口腔中充分霧化感知。

examples.en: We attended an educational coffee cupping workshop to train our sensory palates.
examples.zh: 我們報名參加了一堂專業咖啡感官杯測體驗課程，藉此鍛鍊味蕾對細微風味的敏銳度。

examples.en: Freshly ground roasted coffee beans release an intoxicating chocolate aroma.
examples.zh: 剛研磨破壁的新鮮烘焙咖啡熟豆瞬間在空氣中釋放出令人陶醉的濃郁黑巧克力香氣。

examples.en: The sweet floral aroma of blooming night jasmine filled the warm summer garden.
examples.zh: 盛開的夜來香所散發出的清甜高雅花香，瀰漫在溫暖怡人的夏夜花園中。

examples.en: Inhaling the herbal aroma of boiling peppermint tea cleared his blocked sinuses.
examples.zh: 深吸一口滾燙薄荷茶所蒸騰出的清新草本香氣，頓時讓他阻塞的鼻腔倍感通暢舒緩。

examples.en: High-altitude washed African coffees feature refreshing, wine-like crisp acidity.
examples.zh: 高海拔水洗非洲精品咖啡帶有令人愉悅提神、宛如紅酒般的清脆明亮果酸。

examples.en: Adding a squeeze of fresh lemon juice balances the richness by adding bright acidity.
examples.zh: 擠上一點新鮮檸檬汁能為濃郁的肉料理增添一抹清新明亮的酸度解膩。

examples.en: Soil acidity plays a major role in determining which plants thrive in a mountain garden.
examples.zh: 土壤的酸鹼度（酸性指數）是決定高山農場花卉與作物能否茁壯生長的核心要素。

examples.en: Natural processed beans often produce a heavy, syrupy, velvet mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 日曬處理法與蜜處理生豆往往能在口腔中呈現出如糖漿般濃郁綿密的絲滑口感。

examples.en: Full-fat milk contributes a rich, creamy mouthfeel to specialty milk tea drinks.
examples.zh: 優質全脂鮮乳能為特調精品鮮奶茶帶來極致香醇厚實、柔滑濃郁的滑順口感。

examples.en: The crisp effervescence of the sparkling water provides a pleasant, tingling mouthfeel.
examples.zh: 氣泡水中綿密細緻的微氣泡在舌尖跳躍，帶來清爽微麻、令人愉悅的豐富口感層次。

examples.en: The Geisha coffee left a lingering jasmine aftertaste that lasted for minutes.
examples.zh: 這杯極品藝妓手沖在入喉之後留下了悠長久遠的茉莉花香餘韻，令人回味無窮。

examples.en: High-quality dark chocolate leaves a clean, pleasant aftertaste without bitterness.
examples.zh: 頂級黑巧克力在喉頭融化後會留下乾淨甘醇的悠揚餘韻，絲毫沒有令人不悅的苦澀。

examples.en: Some artificial sweeteners leave an unpleasantly metallic aftertaste on the tongue.
examples.zh: 某些廉價人工代糖在吞嚥之後會在舌尖殘留一股化學金屬般的怪異後味。

words.definition: 綿密細緻微奶泡；蒸氣奶泡

examples.en: Steaming fresh milk to 60°C creates velvety microfoam perfect for latte art.
examples.zh: 將優質鮮乳精準加熱打發至攝氏六十度能產生宛如絲綢般綿密細緻的拉花微奶泡。

examples.en: Submerging the steam wand correctly creates fine microfoam without visible large bubbles.
examples.zh: 將蒸氣噴管正確浸入鮮奶液面適當深度，能打發出毫無粗大氣泡的極細緻微奶泡。

examples.en: Silky microfoam integrates seamlessly with espresso to produce a balanced, sweet cup.
examples.zh: 絲滑柔順的微奶泡能與義式濃縮完美交融，呈現出口感溫潤平衡、甜感充盈的拿鐵。

words.definition: 拿鐵拉花藝術（天鵝、鬱金香、愛心）

examples.en: The barista poured a symmetrical Rosetta leaf pattern in the glossy latte art.
examples.zh: 咖啡師手腕靈活擺動，在咖啡杯表面輕巧勾勒出線條對稱優雅的經典壓紋樹葉拉花。

examples.en: Mastering latte art requires months of steady hand-eye coordination and practice.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握拿鐵拉花藝術需要經過數個月持之以恆的手部穩定度與眼手協調苦練。

examples.en: Customers love photographing the intricate swan latte art before taking their first sip.
examples.zh: 顧客們在啜飲第一口熱拿鐵之前，總是興奮地拿起手機為杯中精緻的天鵝拉花拍照。

examples.en: Steeping coarse coffee grounds in cold water for sixteen hours yields smooth cold brew.
examples.zh: 將研磨咖啡粉浸泡於冰水中長達十六小時低溫慢速冷萃，能產出低酸滑順的冷萃咖啡。

examples.en: Bottled cold brew coffee has become an essential refreshment during hot summer days.
examples.zh: 瓶裝即飲的冷萃黑咖啡已成為炎炎夏日消暑解熱不可或缺的熱門提神飲品首選。

examples.en: Because cold brew is brewed with room temperature water, it has significantly lower acidity.
examples.zh: 由於冷萃咖啡全程採用常溫或冰水長時間慢速萃取，因此其酸質表現極為圓潤溫和。

words.definition: 低因咖啡；去除咖啡因的

examples.en: Enjoy a soothing warm cup of decaf latte without worrying about sleep insomnia.
examples.zh: 在悠閒的夜晚來一杯香濃溫熱的無負擔低因拿鐵，完全不必擔心影響夜晚深度睡眠。

examples.en: She switched to decaf coffee during pregnancy on her doctor's advice.
examples.zh: 懷孕期間聽從婦產科醫生的衛教建議，她將平日的黑咖啡全面更換為無負擔的低因咖啡。

examples.en: Most coffee shops offer Swiss Water process decaf that preserves natural bean flavors.
examples.zh: 大多數精品咖啡館皆提供採用瑞士水處理法脫因的低因咖啡，完整保留了咖啡豆原香。

examples.en: A morning cup of hot black coffee provides a quick caffeine boost for work.
examples.zh: 早晨享用一杯熱騰騰的無糖黑咖啡能提供即時的咖啡因補給，迅速喚醒專注活力。

examples.en: Energy drinks contain high concentrations of caffeine and should be consumed in moderation.
examples.zh: 市售能量提神飲料通常含有高濃度的咖啡因成分，日常飲用時務必保持適量克制。

examples.en: Drinking too much caffeine late in the day can disrupt your normal sleep cycles.
examples.zh: 在傍晚或深夜時分攝取過多咖啡因，極易干擾並打亂人體正常的深層睡眠節律。

examples.en: High-grade whole tea leaves unfurl gracefully in boiling spring water.
examples.zh: 頂級的高山一心二葉手採原葉茶葉在滾燙純淨山泉水中優雅緩慢舒展綻放。

examples.en: Traditional tea masters judge harvest quality by smelling and inspecting dry tea leaves.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的傳統茶道大師透過仔細嗅聞與撫摸乾燥茶葉的外觀來評斷採收年份品質。

examples.en: Discard the spent tea leaves onto the garden compost after multiple infusions.
examples.zh: 在多次沖泡出味完畢後，可以將泡開後的茶渣茶葉倒入花園花盆中作為天然堆肥。

examples.en: Tea connoisseurs can identify the mountain peak harvest region from a single sip.
examples.zh: 資深品茗行家只需輕啜一口茶湯，便能精準辨識出該批茶葉出自哪座高山茶區。

examples.en: As an art connoisseur, she frequently travels abroad to attend prestigious gallery auctions.
examples.zh: 作為一名眼光獨到的藝術鑑賞名家，她經常飛往歐美各地參加頂級藝術畫廊拍賣會。

examples.en: The wine connoisseur praised the vintage for its velvety balance and long finish.
examples.zh: 這位品酒行家由衷讚嘆該年份紅酒單寧如絲絨般圓潤平衡，尾韻悠長回味無窮。

examples.en: Misty green tea plantations blanket the rolling slopes of Mt. Ali.
examples.zh: 終年雲霧繚繞的青翠高山茶園層層疊疊鋪滿了阿里山連綿起伏的壯麗山麓。

examples.en: Many historical coffee plantations offer guided tours and scenic farm stays.
examples.zh: 許多歷史悠久的百年高山咖啡莊園提供專人導覽解說與充滿大自然風情的茶鄉民宿。

examples.en: Workers on the tropical fruit plantation harvest bananas and pineapples by hand.
examples.zh: 這座熱帶水果種植莊園裡的工人們頂著豔陽，以純手工方式熟練採收香蕉與鳳梨。

words.definition: 台灣高山茶（海拔1000公尺以上）

examples.en: Grown above 1,000 meters altitude, Taiwanese high-mountain tea is prized globally.
examples.zh: 種植於海拔一千公尺以上高山帶的台灣高山茶以清香甘醇、喉韻極佳享譽全球。

examples.en: The cool climate and dense mountain fog produce high-mountain tea with gentle sweetness.
examples.zh: 高海拔涼冷清幽的氣候與瀰漫常年的濃霧，孕育出台灣高山茶清甜回甘的頂級滋味。

examples.en: We served freshly brewed Alishan high-mountain tea to our overseas visiting guests.
examples.zh: 我們為遠道而來的外國貴賓沏上一壺熱氣騰騰、清香撲鼻的阿里山原產高山茶。

examples.en: Dong Ding Oolong tea delivers a rich, roasted honey flavor and golden liquor.
examples.zh: 經典鹿谷凍頂烏龍茶散發著迷人的熟果蜜香與碳焙甘醇，茶湯呈現澄澈琥珀金黃。

examples.en: Semi-oxidized Oolong tea strikes a balance between fresh green and robust black teas.
examples.zh: 屬於半發酵青茶的烏龍茶，完美兼具了綠茶的鮮爽清香與全發酵紅茶的濃郁醇厚。

examples.en: Drinking a warm cup of roasted Oolong tea after meals aids digestion pleasantly.
examples.zh: 在大快朵頤享用豐盛大餐後，來上一杯溫潤的慢火炭焙烏龍茶有助於解膩助消化。

words.definition: 東方美人茶；白毫烏龍茶

examples.en: Oriental Beauty tea is bitten by green leafhoppers, creating a natural muscatel honey aroma.
examples.zh: 經小綠葉蟬叮咬著涎的東方美人茶帶有獨一無二的天然純粹蜜糖香與熟果香。

examples.en: Queen Victoria was so impressed by Oriental Beauty tea that she bestowed its elegant name.
examples.zh: 維多利亞女王在品嚐此茶後驚艷讚賞其晶瑩茶湯，因而賜予其優雅動人的「東方美人」美名。

examples.en: The leaves of authentic Oriental Beauty tea display five vibrant shades: white, green, yellow, red, and brown.
examples.zh: 正宗優質東方美人茶的乾茶葉呈現白、綠、黃、紅、褐五色斑斕交織的瑰麗光澤。

words.definition: 全發酵紅茶；日月潭紅茶

examples.en: Sun Moon Lake Ruby Black Tea (No. 18) features hints of natural cinnamon and mint.
examples.zh: 享譽國際的日月潭紅玉紅茶（台茶十八號）茶湯散發著天然肉桂與薄荷的雅緻清香。

examples.en: Many people enjoy black tea with a splash of fresh milk and a spoonful of honey.
examples.zh: 許多人喜歡在濃醇的熱紅茶中注入一勺新鮮鮮奶與天然蜂蜜，調製成香濃奶茶。

examples.en: Fully fermented black tea produces a dark amber liquor with deep malty undertones.
examples.zh: 經過全發酵工藝揉捻精製的紅茶，茶湯呈現深沉典雅的琥珀酒紅，帶有濃郁麥芽香氣。

words.definition: 不發酵綠茶；三峽碧螺春

examples.en: Sanxia Bi Luo Chun is an unfermented green tea packed with fresh grassy sweetness.
examples.zh: 新北三峽碧螺春屬於完全不發酵的鮮嫩綠茶，口感鮮爽甘甜、富含清幽豆香。

examples.en: Green tea is celebrated worldwide for its high content of natural antioxidant catechins.
examples.zh: 綠茶因富含天然高活性兒茶素與強效抗氧化物，在世界各地被譽為頂級健康飲品。

examples.en: Brew delicate green tea with water cooled to 80°C to avoid scorching the tender leaves.
examples.zh: 沖泡鮮嫩頂級的綠茶時建議使用降溫至攝氏八十度的溫熱水，以免燙傷嬌嫩茶芽。

examples.en: Skilled tea pluckers harvest the tender 'one tip, two leaves' at daybreak.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的採茶阿姨在破曉清晨俐落採摘最鮮嫩的一心二葉頂級茶菁嫩芽。

examples.en: Hand plucking ensures that only undamaged, young leaves are selected for processing.
examples.zh: 人工手採採茶工序能確保只有完整無損、最鮮嫩肥厚的嫩葉才會被挑選送入茶廠精製。

examples.en: The timing of tea plucking depends heavily on daily weather and dew evaporation.
examples.zh: 春茶採摘的黃金時機高度仰賴當天的晴朗天氣與晨露蒸發完全的時間點。

examples.en: Solar withering under mild morning sunshine reduces moisture inside freshly picked leaves.
examples.zh: 將剛採下的茶菁在溫暖柔和的晨曦下進行日光萎凋，能均勻蒸發茶葉內部多餘水分。

examples.en: Indoor withering allows enzymatic reactions to develop complex floral aromas slowly.
examples.zh: 室內靜置萎凋能促使茶葉細胞內的天然酵素溫和轉化，慢慢生發出迷人的清雅花香。

examples.en: Careful control during the withering phase is essential for producing aromatic oolong tea.
examples.zh: 在製茶的萎凋階段進行精準的溫濕度控管，是產出頂級高香烏龍茶的關鍵基礎。

examples.en: Controlling oxidation levels determines whether tea becomes green, oolong, or black.
examples.zh: 精準控制茶葉發酵氧化程度的深淺，是決定製成綠茶、烏龍茶或全發酵紅茶之關鍵。

examples.en: Enzymatic oxidation transforms bitter polyphenols into sweet and fragrant compounds.
examples.zh: 茶葉內部的酵素氧化作用能將生澀的茶多酚分子轉化為甘甜醇厚且芬芳的香氣成分。

examples.en: Unlike oolong, green tea leaves undergo rapid pan-firing to stop oxidation completely.
examples.zh: 與烏龍茶不同，綠茶採摘後會立即送入高溫炒鍋中殺青，以徹底中止酵素氧化作用。

examples.en: Heavy machine rolling twists oolong leaves into tight, semi-spherical jade pearls.
examples.zh: 透過反覆布球揉捻塑形工法，將烏龍茶葉揉捻成顆粒緊結、宛如翠玉珍珠般的半球型。

examples.en: The mechanical rolling process ruptures leaf cells and brings essential oils to the surface.
examples.zh: 機械反覆加壓揉捻能適度破壞茶葉表面細胞壁，使茶葉天然芳香油脂均勻溢出附著。

examples.en: Artisan tea makers inspect the firmness of the tea pellets throughout the rolling process.
examples.zh: 專業製茶師傅在整個繁複的揉捻過程中，會隨時解塊並仔細檢查茶球的緊實度與成型。

examples.en: Traditional charcoal roasting over longan wood imparts a deep, smoky sweetness.
examples.zh: 遵古法採用天然龍眼木炭慢火炭焙茶葉，能賦予茶湯深沉甘美、溫潤厚實的炭焙韻味。

examples.en: Master roasters monitor the charcoal embers day and night to maintain steady baking heat.
examples.zh: 焙茶大師日以繼夜輪班照看炭火盆中的微弱炭火餘燼，以維持極為恆定的文火慢焙。

examples.en: The subtle charcoal notes linger pleasingly in the mouth long after the cup is finished.
examples.zh: 慢火炭焙所轉化出的迷人木質炭香，在整杯茶飲盡之後依然在口齒間久久繚繞不散。

examples.en: Brewing Gongfu tea requires precise water temperatures, short steeps, and mindful focus.
examples.zh: 沖泡傳統功夫茶席需要掌握滾水高溫、短秒數多次快沖以及全神貫注的靜心品鑑。

examples.en: The Gongfu tea ceremony is a revered art form that honors hospitality and craftsmanship.
examples.zh: 功夫茶茶藝是一門推崇深厚待客之道與極致匠人精神、備受推崇的傳統東方藝術。

examples.en: Practicing Gongfu tea encourages participants to slow down and savor each unique infusion.
examples.zh: 靜心修習工夫茶能引導品茗者放慢繁雜的心緒步調，逐一細細品味每一泡茶湯的幽微變化。

examples.en: Porous purple clay Yixing teapots absorb tea oils and enhance flavor over decades.
examples.zh: 透氣性極佳的宜興紫砂茶壺能吸收茶湯精華油脂，長年泡養更能讓茶湯越發香醇。

examples.en: She poured hot water into the ceramic teapot to warm it before adding loose leaves.
examples.zh: 她在放入茶葉前先將滾燙熱水注入陶瓷小茶壺中進行溫壺，以確保泡茶溫度充沛。

examples.en: An antique cast-iron teapot sat quietly on the stove, warming the cozy dining room.
examples.zh: 一只古色古香的日本手工鑄鐵壺靜靜坐在火爐上煨著熱水，為溫馨的飯廳帶來融融暖意。

examples.en: A porcelain Gaiwan allows tea appraisers to examine wet leaf aromas directly.
examples.zh: 白瓷蓋碗能真實還原茶湯原味不奪香，方便評茶師掀開碗蓋直接聞香鑑賞葉底。

examples.en: Using a Gaiwan gives the brewer complete control over steep time and pouring speed.
examples.zh: 熟練使用蓋碗沖茶能讓泡茶者對茶葉浸潤秒數與出湯傾倒流速擁有百分之百的掌控。

examples.en: The traditional Gaiwan consists of three pieces: a saucer, a bowl, and a fitting lid.
examples.zh: 傳統標準蓋碗由三個部分組裝而成：承托托盤、盛水杯碗本體以及貼合嚴密的碗蓋。

examples.en: Pour brewed tea from the pot into a glass pitcher to ensure equal concentration.
examples.zh: 將泡好的茶湯先倒出至玻璃茶海（公道杯）中勻湯，確保分給每位客人的茶湯濃度一致。

examples.en: A clear glass pitcher allows guests to admire the vibrant golden color of the tea liquor.
examples.zh: 澄澈通透的耐熱玻璃茶海能讓圍坐茶席的客人共同欣賞茶湯晶瑩剔透的金黃琥珀色澤。

examples.en: She poured iced lemonade from the crystal pitcher to refresh everyone on the patio.
examples.zh: 她從晶瑩的水晶大水壺中倒出冰涼的檸檬水，為坐在庭院陽台上的所有親友消暑解渴。

examples.en: Steep the high-mountain oolong leaves for 45 seconds during the first infusion.
examples.zh: 第一泡高山烏龍茶原葉建議浸泡萃取約四十五秒鐘即可迅速出湯出水。

examples.en: Don't steep the green tea leaves for too long, or the brew will turn unpleasantly bitter.
examples.zh: 沖泡鮮嫩綠茶時切忌浸泡時間過久，否則茶湯容易析出過多單寧而變得苦澀難嚥。

examples.en: We had to climb a steep, rocky mountain trail to reach the historic hilltop temple.
examples.zh: 我們必須沿著一條陡峭崎嶇的岩石山間小徑手腳並用攀爬，才能抵達山頂的古老寺廟。

words.definition: 泡茶回數；茶湯沖泡；注入

examples.en: Premium Taiwanese oolongs maintain rich flavor through seven consecutive infusions.
examples.zh: 頂級台灣高山烏龍茶極其耐泡，連續沖泡回沖七次以上依然茶香四溢、甘甜不減。

examples.en: Each subsequent infusion reveals deeper mineral notes and nuanced fruit sweetness.
examples.zh: 隨後的每一泡回沖茶湯皆會逐層綻放出更深邃的岩韻礦物感與細膩豐富的熟果甜感。

examples.en: A hot chamomile infusion before bedtime helps calm nerves and promotes restful sleep.
examples.zh: 在就寢前喝上一杯熱騰騰的純天然洋甘菊舒壓草本茶飲，能平撫神經並幫助一夜好眠。

examples.en: The high-mountain tea reveals an enchanting orchid floral bouquet in the scent cup.
examples.zh: 將聞香杯湊近鼻尖輕嗅，高山茶湯散發出如高雅幽蘭般清麗脫俗的迷人花香。

examples.en: She wore a breezy summer dress decorated with delicate floral prints.
examples.zh: 她身上穿著一襲輕柔飄逸的純棉夏日連身裙，裙擺點綴著雅緻細膩的碎花印花圖案。

examples.en: The honey carried a subtle floral fragrance gathered from spring wildflower blossoms.
examples.zh: 這瓶純天然蜂蜜蘊含著工蜂從春天百花野花叢中所採集而來的清幽淡雅花香。

examples.en: A sweet, cooling finish lingering in the throat is the hallmark of great tea.
examples.zh: 飲下熱茶後喉頭湧現一股甘涼生津、久久不散的甜美喉韻回甘，是頂級好茶的標誌。

examples.en: He used fine sandpaper to achieve a glossy, satin finish on the wooden tabletop.
examples.zh: 他用極細的水砂紙細細打磨，使手工原木餐桌表面呈現出如絲緞般溫潤光滑的表面質感。

examples.en: The long marathon runners sprinted with all their remaining energy toward the finish line.
examples.zh: 馬拉松長跑選手們使出渾身剩餘的每一分體力全力衝刺，奔向眼前萬眾矚目的終點線。

words.definition: 回甘（茶道術語，甘甜回味）

examples.en: 'Huigan' refers to the delightful sweet aftertaste rising in your throat after swallowing.
examples.zh: 「回甘」（Huigan）是指吞下微苦茶湯後，喉嚨深處自然湧現轉化出的甘甜回韻感受。

examples.en: Connoisseurs judge exceptional Taiwanese oolong teas primarily by the depth of their Huigan.
examples.zh: 頂級評茶行家在評鑑台灣高山烏龍茶的優劣時，往往將喉韻回甘的深度與持久度列為首要標準。

examples.en: A strong Huigan leaves your palate feeling refreshed and naturally sweet for long afterwards.
examples.zh: 勁道十足的茶氣回甘能讓整個口腔與喉嚨感覺清爽生津，長久停留著天然的甘美清甜。

examples.en: Well-crafted tea transforms pleasant mild astringency into immediate mouth-watering sweetness.
examples.zh: 製作精良的優等茶能將初入口時的微弱茶澀感秒速化為滿口生津的大回甘。

examples.en: Over-steeping black tea brings out harsh astringency that dries out your tongue.
examples.zh: 浸泡時間過長的濃紅茶會析出過量粗澀的單寧酸，使整個舌面感到乾澀緊繃。

examples.en: Unripe persimmons contain heavy astringency that tastes chalky and puckering.
examples.zh: 尚未完全成熟脫澀的生柿子含有高濃度的可溶性單寧，吃起來口感極為乾澀麻舌。

examples.en: Tourists enjoy drinking fragrant oolong at historic lantern-lit Jiufen teahouses.
examples.zh: 國內外觀光客在紅燈籠高掛、古色古香的九份山城老字號茶藝館悠閒品茗賞景。

examples.en: The tranquil hillside teahouse overlooks sweeping vistas of misty terraced valleys.
examples.zh: 這間隱身於青翠半山腰的清幽茶坊，能飽覽層層疊疊、雲霧繚繞的壯麗梯田山景。

examples.en: We spent a rainy afternoon chatting and tasting different teas inside a quiet traditional teahouse.
examples.zh: 我們在一個細雨霏霏的午後，躲進古樸溫馨的傳統茶藝館裡悠哉品茶、促膝長談。

examples.en: Professional tea appraisal competitions award coveted Champion Prizes annually.
examples.zh: 全台各地農會每年盛大舉辦嚴謹的優良茶評鑑比賽，由評茶專家盲測選出特等獎。

examples.en: The bank conducted a thorough appraisal of the property before approving the mortgage.
examples.zh: 銀行在正式核發購屋房屋貸款之前，派遣專業估價師對該不動產進行了全面的價值鑑價。

examples.en: Annual performance appraisal provides employees with constructive career feedback.
examples.zh: 公司每年度舉辦的員工考績績效評核能為同仁提供具建設性的職涯反饋與晉升建議。

examples.en: Connoisseurs always prefer loose-leaf tea over mass-market commercial tea dust.
examples.zh: 真正懂茶的茶道愛好者始終偏好沖泡散裝完整原葉茶，而非市售機械碎茶末茶包。

examples.en: Loose-leaf tea allows you to adjust the leaf-to-water ratio according to your preference.
examples.zh: 購買散裝原葉茶能讓泡茶者根據自己的濃淡口味喜好，隨心所欲自由調配茶水比例。

examples.en: Store your loose-leaf tea in an opaque, airtight canister away from heat and direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 請將珍貴的原葉散裝茶妥善存放在避光且密封防潮的不透光茶葉鐵罐中，避免受熱與日曬。

examples.en: Pyramidal corn-starch tea sachets let whole leaves expand completely in mugs.
examples.zh: 玉米澱粉環保材質製成的三角立體原葉茶包能讓大茶葉在馬克杯中全然舒展萃取。

examples.en: She placed a lavender-scented sachet inside her wardrobe to keep her clothes smelling fresh.
examples.zh: 她在自家衣櫥抽屜裡放進了一個薰衣草芳香小香包，讓所有換季衣物常保芳香芬芳。

examples.en: Single-serve tea sachets make it convenient to enjoy high-quality oolong at the office.
examples.zh: 單包裝的原葉立體隨身茶包非常方便好攜帶，讓上班族在辦公室也能輕鬆沖泡現飲好茶。

words.definition: 專注當下的；正念靜心的

examples.en: Preparing tea slowly serves as a peaceful, mindful meditation after a hectic day.
examples.zh: 忙碌了一整天後，放慢步調靜下心來為自己沏上一壺熱茶，是最撫慰人心的正念冥想。

examples.en: Be mindful of your posture when sitting in front of your computer for long hours.
examples.zh: 長時間坐在電腦螢幕前辦公伏案時，請務必隨時留意並維持端正良好的坐姿習慣。

examples.en: Practicing mindful breathing helps calm racing thoughts during stressful moments.
examples.zh: 在面臨高壓緊張的時刻，練習將注意力放回深層的深呼吸能快速平復紛亂的思緒。

words.definition: 沉靜安寧；寧靜祥和之美 (Zen)

examples.en: The minimalist tea room created an atmosphere of pure tranquility and timeless serenity.
examples.zh: 充滿東方侘寂極簡美學的人文茶席空間營造出一種超脫塵俗、純淨安詳的沉靜祥和。

examples.en: Walking through the quiet bamboo forest filled her spirit with peace and serenity.
examples.zh: 漫步穿梭於寂靜幽深的翠綠竹林步道之間，讓她的心靈瞬間充滿了平靜與祥和之感。

examples.en: The calm lake reflected the mountains at sunrise, creating a scene of breathtaking serenity.
examples.zh: 清晨平靜無波的湖面如鏡子般倒映著連綿的遠山朝陽，構成一幅令人摒息的空靈寧靜畫卷。
